title: Slice 1: command-contract conformance and .gitignore source discovery
description: DEC-216 (opum-doc, 2026-10-20), Q7 and its 'also fix' clause. Glyph must conform to the frozen Opum command contract (opum-doc docs/specs/opum-command-contract.md) before any consumer depends on its output: principal on both envelopes, the {error_type, message, principal} error shape, a dotted kind registry discoverable through glyph help --json, and the full exit-code family. Source discovery must honour .gitignore instead of a fixed directory list. Requested by opum-agent for ODOC-487, relayed 2026-10-20.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every successful `--json` result is exactly {schemaVersion, kind, data, principal}, with `principal: null` as the last top-level key; an envelope that omits the key fails the conformance test.

Every failure under `--json` writes {error_type, message, principal: null} to stderr with stdout empty; a classified failure and an uncaught crash share that shape, and `principal` is the last key in both.

Every command that supports `--json` emits a stable dotted `command.payload` kind taken by lookup from the live registry, and a program-walk plus an end-to-end test prove the handlers and the registry cannot drift.

`glyph help --json` emits kind `help.manifest`, whose data lists every command with its kind, flags and exit codes, plus the full exit-code taxonomy {ok: 0, uncaught: 1, usage: 2, not_found: 3, denied: 4, conflict: 5, validation: 6, drift: 6, indeterminate: 7}.

The full exit-code family is implemented and mapped per the frozen contract: 0 ok, 1 uncaught, 2 usage (including an ambiguous symbol), 3 not_found, 4 denied, 5 conflict, 6 validation/drift, 7 indeterminate; one mapper decides every code, and every successful `--json` help or version invocation emits an envelope rather than plain text.

A conformance test enumerates kinds and exit codes from live source, asserts exact equality with a golden set (non-vacuous), and is proven to fail for an empty golden map, a corrupted golden kind, a corrupted live kind, a malformed kind under a mutated dotted-kind check, a missing command and an out-of-family code.

Source discovery honours .gitignore, including nested .gitignore files, negation patterns and untracked non-ignored files; an untracked ignored source never enters the index, a tracked file stays visible even when a pattern matches it, and a Git repository Git refuses to describe is indeterminate (7) rather than a silent walk.

Tests cover a root ignore file, a nested ignore file, a negated pattern, an unignored untracked source, a backslash-named file and a refused repository; `callers` and `diff` answers are unchanged except where a repository tracks files the old fixed list excluded (dist/, vendor/, build/, or an unignored node_modules/), a change named in ADR 0002 and README; `bun run check` passes.

plan: 1. Establish the shared envelope, error shape and full exit-code taxonomy in src/errors.ts and a new src/contract.ts registry.
2. Convert every command to the dotted kind registry and add `glyph help --json` emitting help.manifest from live source.
3. Add the success/error envelope presence checks and the non-vacuous conformance test, proven against deliberate violations.
4. Replace the fixed-directory walk in src/discover.ts with .gitignore-honouring discovery and cover root, nested, negated and untracked cases.
5. Update README and tests, run bun run check, open the PR, and report head and checks before any land.
implementationNotes:
Opus review verdict on opum-ai/glyph-cli#34 at ccb30ef6, recorded verbatim from opum-agent's relay (reviewer claude-opus-5-5, no shell; it read commander 15.0.0 from node_modules, which matches the pin): REQUEST CHANGES: 1 BLOCKING, 3 MAJOR, 8 MINOR.

HOLDS:
- principal is last on both shapes (contract.ts:34-41);
- every error path writes to stderr with stdout empty (cli.ts:226-253);
- ls-files is argv-only, -z and NUL-split, deduped, and lifts a subdirectory --repo.

1. BLOCKING: the kind registry is NOT derived from live source, and the conformance test compares two hand-written lists (contract.ts:68-114; handlers emit literals at cli.ts:141, 172, 193, 200 and 220). Changing cli.ts:193 to "cache.paths" passes every test, and so does adding `program.command("symbols")` with no COMMANDS entry. That falsifies AC2, README.md:67 and ADR 0002:56. Fix:
   - handlers take their kind from COMMANDS by lookup;
   - move buildProgram out of cli.ts, since cli.ts:256 runs run() on import;
   - add a test walking buildProgram().commands (mapping `cache <action>` to its two entries);
   - add an end-to-end test asserting every command's emitted kind equals its registry entry.

2. MAJOR: some successful --json runs print plain text on stdout with exit 0: `glyph --json help callers` (cli.ts:217), and `--json --version`, `--json --help` and `callers --help --json` (cli.ts:247). Read what the frozen contract says about help and version (opum-doc docs/specs/opum-command-contract.md, by ref). Emit an envelope, or cite the contract's exemption, and test either way. If the contract is silent, send me the A/B; do not guess.

3. MAJOR: a bare `glyph` (or `glyph --json`) loses its help. Commander writes help via writeErr, which is a no-op at cli.ts:105, then throws commander.help "(outputHelp)", which becomes usage, exit 2. Add a test for a bare invocation.

4. MAJOR: discovery fails open to the walk whenever git refuses (discover.ts:37-50, cli.ts:58). For example, "dubious ownership" (exit 128) on a checkout owned by another UID silently walks and indexes ignored sources, against AC6. Fall back only when the directory is genuinely not a repository; otherwise exit indeterminate (7), or report the degraded selection.

MINORs, all cheap, so fix them:
5. The violation tests corrupt only the golden side; also corrupt `live`, and mutate the DOTTED_KIND check itself.
6. run() maps exit codes itself and never calls exitCodeFor (errors.ts:39 against cli.ts:241-252). Use the one mapper, and add end-to-end tests for uncaught/1 and for a --json commander usage error.
7. git.ts:87 maps a failed `git diff` on resolved refs to usage (2); it should be indeterminate (7) or uncaught (1).
8. The manifest exitCodes omit 1 for every command (contract.ts:75-111).
9. AC7 "existing answers unchanged" does not hold in Git repos, where tracked dist/, vendor/ and build/, or an unignored node_modules/, now enter the index. Make it hold, or state the change and why in the ADR and README.
10. AC6 and README.md:117 should say "untracked ignored".
11. Document the submodule and nested-repo skip, the symlink following, and the walk's fixed directory list. Fix discover.ts:46's backslash rewrite, which loses a POSIX file named `a\b.ts`.
12. ADR 0002:10 is stamped lore/0.14.1, while GCLI-9 claims 0.13.0. Regenerate it with the pinned 0.13.0, or correct the claim.

Then push, read CI on the full head, add a review worktree at it, and report the head, the worktree and the checks. One confirmatory Opus review follows. Do not land.
finalSummary: Command-contract conformance and .gitignore source discovery landed on PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#34. The run that validated the deliverable is 39512972156 on 297cea4, where Check, Docs and Tracker integrity are all green; it does not cover the tracker-only move that follows. Both envelopes carry principal as the last top-level key (success {schemaVersion, kind, data, principal}; failure {error_type, message, principal} on stderr with stdout empty), kinds are dotted command.payload values published from the live registry by glyph help --json as help.manifest, and the full 0-7 exit-code family is mapped in one table. test/contract.test.ts enumerates the registry and taxonomy against a golden set, asserts non-vacuity and is proven against deliberate violations. Discovery now uses git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard, so .gitignore, nested ignore files, negation and untracked non-ignored sources are honoured. ADR 0002 records the contract's local obligation and names the conformance test. Verified locally by bun run check (Bun 1.3.14; repository pin 1.4.2) and lore validate/check --strict under lore 0.13.0.
